observacoes: Cenario denso e rico, com hierarquia de acesso de 4 niveis (departamento/faculdade/universidade/usuario base) e RNFs bem explicitos e mensuraveis (200 usuarios, 30min timeout, SSL, CAPTCHA) — raro entre os 9 cenarios. Conteudo em ingles porque o cenario-fonte e em ingles (mesma convencao dos gabaritos RAGAS existentes).

em_escopo: Unified login for all user types, with an extra verification step (voice check) for higher-access users
Looking up, adding, and editing people, assets, locations, and licenses
Marking deleted records as inactive (never physical removal, to preserve history)
Grouping and splitting assets and rooms into subgroups
Importing legacy data from CSV files
Request-and-approval flow (move item, report broken, request new asset) with hierarchical routing and mandatory explanation on rejection
4-level access hierarchy (department, faculty, university, base user)
Quick search and advanced/filtered search with combinable conditions
Basic report comparing a room's capacity against its actual chairs/computers
Audit log of all user actions
fora_de_escopo: Deeper department/faculty-specific functions — deferred to a later version
premissas: PA-01: [INFERRED] A voice-check verification provider is available for integration into the login of higher-access users.
PA-02: Legacy inventory data exists in CSV files exportable from each faculty's current systems.
restricoes: REST-01 (Scope): Version 1 is English-only; multi-language support is deferred to a later version.
REST-02 (Performance): The system must support at least 200 concurrent users.
REST-03 (Technical): The system must be a browser-accessible web application, requiring no special software installation.

stakeholders.descricao: Base user (students, staff) — logs in with a password, access restricted to what is relevant to them.
Department admin — sees and manages only their own department's data; approves requests from base users below them.
Faculty admin — sees and manages all departments under their faculty; login requires an extra verification step (voice check).
University-level admin — top of the hierarchy; their requests are approved automatically, since there is no approver above them; manages permissions and roles.

regras_de_negocio.descricao: Higher-access users (department, faculty, and university admins) require an extra verification step (voice check) at login, in addition to a password.
Deleted records are never physically removed — only marked as inactive, to preserve history.
Requests to move an item, report something broken, or request a new asset go to the approver exactly one level above the requester.
Rejected requests require an explanation from the approver.
Requests from university-level admins are automatically approved, since there is no approver above them.
A faculty admin can access all departments in their faculty; a department admin only sees their own department.
Permission and role management is an admin-only feature.

requisitos_funcionais.descricao: The system must allow all user types to log in through a unified system.
The system must require an extra verification step (voice check) at login for higher-access users, in addition to a password.
The system must allow users to look up people, assets, locations, and licenses.
The system must allow users to add new people, assets, locations, and licenses.
The system must allow users to edit existing people, assets, locations, and licenses.
The system must mark a record as inactive when deleted, instead of physically removing it.
The system must allow assets and rooms to be grouped and split into subgroups.
The system must support importing legacy data from CSV files.
The system must allow users to submit requests to move an item, report something broken, or request a new asset.
The system must route each request to the approver exactly one level above the requester.
The system must require an explanation from the approver when a request is rejected.
The system must automatically approve requests submitted by university-level admins.
The system must restrict a department admin's access to only their own department's data.
The system must allow a faculty admin to access data for all departments in their faculty.
The system must offer a quick search (simple text).
The system must offer an advanced/filtered search with combinable conditions across different fields.
The system must provide a basic report comparing a room's stated capacity against its actual number of chairs/computers.
The system must log all user actions for audit purposes, retrievable by users with appropriate permission.
The system must allow admins to manage permissions and create/edit roles.

requisitos_nao_funcionais.descricao: The system must support at least 200 concurrent users without noticeable degradation.
Inactive sessions must automatically time out after a period of inactivity.
requisitos_nao_funcionais.metrica_aceitacao: Automatic timeout after 30 minutes of inactivity

requisitos_nao_funcionais.descricao: Unsaved data must be recoverable without loss if the session or connection is interrupted.
requisitos_nao_funcionais.metrica_aceitacao: [TBD] — scenario does not define a maximum recovery window, only requires 'without loss'

requisitos_nao_funcionais.descricao: All network communication in the system must be encrypted.
Automated (bot) actions must be blocked using CAPTCHA, especially on login.
requisitos_nao_funcionais.metrica_aceitacao: CAPTCHA present on the login flow

requisitos_nao_funcionais.descricao: The system must be a browser-accessible web application, requiring no special software installation.
requisitos_nao_funcionais.metrica_aceitacao: Accessible via a standard browser, no plugin/additional installation

historias_de_usuario.descricao: As a base user (student/staff), I want to log in and see only what's relevant to me, so that I can manage my own view of the inventory without irrelevant data.
As a higher-access user, I want to complete an extra verification step (voice check) at login, so that my elevated access is protected beyond just a password.
As a user, I want to look up, add, and edit people, assets, locations, and licenses, so that the inventory stays up to date.
As a user, I want to submit a request to move an item, report something broken, or request a new asset, so that the right approver can review it.
As an approver, I want to approve or reject requests from users one level below me, explaining any rejection, so that the requester understands the decision.
As a department admin, I want to see and manage only my own department's data, so that I don't interfere with other departments.
As a faculty admin, I want to see and manage all departments in my faculty, so that I have full oversight of it.
As a user, I want to search using quick search or advanced/filtered search, so that I can find records efficiently.
As a user with reporting access, I want to compare a room's capacity against its actual chairs/computers, so that I can identify discrepancies.
As an admin, I want to manage permissions and roles, so that I can control what each role is allowed to access.

casos_de_uso.descricao: Submit and approve request — a user submits a request (move item/report broken/new asset), the system routes it to the approver one level above, who approves or rejects it with an explanation (or it is auto-approved if the requester is a university-level admin).
Search inventory — a user performs a quick or advanced/filtered search across people, assets, locations, and licenses.
Import legacy data — an admin imports historical inventory data from a CSV file.
Generate room capacity report — a user runs a report comparing a room's stated capacity against its actual chairs/computers.
Manage roles and permissions — an admin creates or edits roles and adjusts what each role can access.

criterios_de_aceite.descricao: Given a higher-access user attempting to log in, when they enter their password, then the system requires an additional voice verification before granting access.
Given a user submits a request, when it is sent, then the system routes it to the approver exactly one level above the requester.
Given a university-level admin submits a request, when it is sent, then the system approves it automatically, without requiring further approval.
Given 200 concurrent users accessing the system, when they perform normal operations, then the system remains responsive without failing.
Given a user session with no activity, when 30 minutes pass, then the system automatically ends the session.
